summary: Comprehensive testing of Salada Soul food ordering app. All backend APIs (23/23 tests) passing. Frontend fully functional with correct menu hierarchy, add-on system, cart, checkout and admin panel.
passed_tests: GET /api/categories - returns 4 categories: Monte sua Salada, Saladas Prontas, Lanches Frios, Bebidas
GET /api/products - returns 13 products with correct fields
Monte sua Salada has 35 add-ons grouped by 7 categories (base_folhas, proteina, legumes, frutas, extras, molhos, temperos)
GET /api/products?category_id=X - filters products by category correctly
UI: Menu page loads with 4 category sidebar navigation
UI: Clicking category changes displayed products
UI: Monte sua Salada modal shows add-ons grouped by category with icons
UI: Selecting add-ons updates total price correctly (R$ 28.50 base + R$ 9.00 Frango + R$ 2.50 Tomate = R$ 40.00)
UI: Add to cart works with toast notification
UI: Cart shows items with selected add-ons
UI: Checkout page displays order summary with delivery options (Retirada/Entrega)
UI: Admin login redirects to /admin/pedidos after successful authentication
UI: Admin orders page shows all orders with status management
UI: Admin Cardapio page shows products with Menus/Categorias/Produtos/Opcionais tabs
seed_data_creation: Real menu data already seeded with: Monte sua Salada (R$ 28.50 base + 35 add-ons), 5 Saladas Prontas, 2 Lanches Frios, 5 Bebidas
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features working correctly. The app has proper data-testid attributes for automation. Monte sua Salada product has 35 add-ons grouped by 7 categories. Admin panel is fully functional with order management and product CRUD.
